source.geometry: Unchanged building.positions.bin original measured points; western upper rim only
source.footprint: Manual image trace checked against analysis/building-reference.png and analysis/roof-support.png

metadata.method: Constrained aerial footprint; robust 95th-percentile rim height stations, 3-station median, PCHIP along measured rim; constant transverse extrapolation at each closest rim station

baselineCoverage.method: Vertical ray intersections with unchanged building-surface.glb within 0.35 m of rim-estimated roof

metadata.uvConvention: u=(E-xmin)/(xmax-xmin), v=(ymax-N)/(ymax-ymin); image top is v=0

confidence.footprint: Image-constrained, manually traced; not a surveyed outline
confidence.height: Measured upper-rim constrained longitudinally; transverse roof shape unobserved

metadata.limits: Estimated aerial-informed infill. Roof interior and transverse curvature are not measured; closest-rim height is interpolated across the reflective gap. Upper-wall/parapet returns may bias roof height. Aerial has finite resolution and may predate the scan. This patch has no 0.32 m surface-to-scan accuracy claim; no hidden facade is inferred. Original points and measured surface remain unchanged.
